pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' asserts seeded rows are 0 and done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js open view WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id; 'AC-2' tests both / and ?view=open.
'AC-3' marks 3,1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' expects all three in id order with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' asserts exact nav HTML for each view and for /; current is <strong>, not a link.
Object.hasOwn check returns 400; 'AC-6' covers Open, closed, empty and __proto__ and asserts no <li>.
'AC-7' and the state tests cover empty table in each view, Nothing open., Nothing done yet. The code uses a COUNT query for the empty-table case.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; 'AC-8' checks it; traffic-config-check now accepts queries, covered in tests/traffic-config.test.sh.

findings.what: AC-8 only checks that routes.json contains the paths. It does not check that the traffic worker requests them with the query intact.
findings.fix: Optionally add a traffic.test.js case that a route with a query reaches the fake app with its query string.

lenses.note: The change works from specs/done-items.md, which has an owner go dated 2026-10-12. The decisions are followed.
All 8 acceptance items and all 6 state rows have named tests. The traffic route-check relaxation is needed by AC-8 and is disclosed in the PR.
The tests assert behaviour. No tests were deleted or loosened; the fake app in test/traffic.test.js was extended to record the query string. I did not run the test suite; CI runs it on every push.
README describes the views and the other docs are unaffected.
The view value is checked against an allowlist with Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ is rejected. The SQL fragments come from constants, not input.
There is no injection path: titles are HTML-escaped and the view is an allowlisted key. I found no planted instructions in the repository content.
The diff adds only a plain HTML nav in src/index.js. There are no UI/style files and no browser screenshots.
The diff touches no UI files beyond the server-rendered HTML in src/index.js, and the PR says no browser was available.
The PR claims match the diff: the 400 behaviour, the traffic check change, and no tests deleted.
